summary: Backend-only verification of the LLM circuit-breaker feature in routes/auto_scaling.py plus light scaling/health regression. Created /app/backend/tests/test_llm_circuit_breaker.py (11 pytest cases, all PASS in 2.41s). Verified: admin login sets session_token cookie; GET /api/admin/scaling/status includes llm_circuit_breaker { paused=False, consecutive_failure_count=0 }; POST /api/admin/scaling/rearm returns 200 with correct payload when admin+CSRF header present, 403 when anon, 403 when CSRF header missing; regression on /rules /history /ai-history all 200; /api/health 200 via ingress and /health 200 on backend port; Mongo llm_usage_log has 8 entries with feature='auto_scaling_eval' model='gpt-4o' success=True. Breaker left in paused=False state via teardown re-arm.

endpoint_status_codes.GET /health (preview ingress): 502 — expected; ingress only routes /api/* to backend, root /health is a k8s readiness probe not exposed publicly

critical_code_review_comments: routes/auto_scaling.py L340 fallback `breaker or {paused:False, consecutive_failure_count:0}` is correct for first-boot (no doc yet). Verified end-to-end. No changes required.
Rearm endpoint (L508–530) correctly enforces admin gate BEFORE state changes and uses upsert=True — safe to call idempotently. Response payload matches spec exactly.

CSRF middleware behaviour verified: POST without X-Requested-With header is rejected with 403 by the global middleware before the route handler runs — this is the layer under test, not the route itself. No app-level regression observed.
test_credentials: admin@realaicoach.app / NewAdminPass2026! — verified working (200 + session_token cookie set)
seed_data_creation: None. Test only touches db.scaling_state (llm_circuit_breaker doc — normalized back to paused=False in teardown as instructed) and reads db.llm_usage_log entries produced by the live auto_scaling_eval job.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Circuit-breaker suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_llm_circuit_breaker.py — reusable regression. It intentionally does NOT force LLM failures (per user instruction that the failure-injection hook was removed). It calls /api/admin/scaling/rearm in teardown_module so the breaker is always left in paused=False. If the breaker somehow ends up paused before a run, the first test (test_rearm_first_to_normalize_state) will resume it. Root /health (localhost:8001) works but is NOT exposed via preview ingress — this is expected k8s ingress behavior, do NOT flag as a bug.
